'''Zhari Vaal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] who was a member of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh's]] ruling council, the [[Neshtovar]], in the era prior to the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. As a member of the Neshtovar, Vaal was a skilled [[uvak]]-rider, although he often mistreated his flying uvak beast, [[Nink (uvak)|Nink]]. He was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to [[Adari Vaal]]&mdash;although theirs was a quite unhappy marriage&mdash;and their nine-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] union [[Reproduction/Legends|produced]] two [[Youngling/Legends|children]], [[Tona Vaal|Tona]] and [[Finn Vaal]]. Zhari was eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]] when Nink, provoked by Vaal's constant abuse, dropped him into an [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]].

==Biography==
[[File:Adari_Vaal.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Adari Vaal, Zhari Vaal's wife]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]], Zhari Vaal was a [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. As a member of the planet's ruling [[Neshtovar]], Vaal was one of the few Keshiri adept at riding Kesh's native flying [[uvak]] beasts. Vaal was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to a woman named [[Adari Vaal|Adari]]&mdash;the match came about after [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of lobbying by Adari's ambitious [[Parent/Legends|mother]], [[Eulyn]]. The Vaals were together for nine years, a relatively unhappy union that [[Reproduction/Legends|produced]] two [[Youngling/Legends|children]], [[Tona Vaal|Tona]] and [[Finn Vaal|Finn]]. Although Zhari's profession revolved around the uvak creatures he rode as a member of the Neshtovar, Vaal was abusive toward his mount, [[Nink (uvak)|Nink]].<ref name="skyborn" />

Around [[5000 BBY]],<ref name="date" /> Nink, after being mistreated by Vaal, flew the man far out over an [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] and dropped him. Vaal was [[Death/Legends|killed]] but remembered fondly at his wake, eulogized by Neshtovar member [[Izri Dazh]] as "the valiant young rider of the Neshtovar on whom so many hopes rested." While his widow, Adari, went on to absorb herself in her work as a [[Geologist/Legends|geologist]], Vaal's children were taken care of by his mother-in-law, Eulyn.<ref name="skyborn" /> 

Later that year, Adari witnessed the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Yaru Korsin]]&mdash;who was stranded on Kesh&mdash;[[Duel near the Omen|kill]] his brother [[Devore Korsin]] and throw him off a cliff into the sea. When Adari later confronted Korsin about it, Korsin assured her that Devore was a threat and brought up that Zhari had also died in that sea, though Adari insisted she had nothing to do with his death.<ref name="skyborn" /> After Adari's death in [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] in the far-off continent of [[Alanciar]], [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] after Vaal's demise, Adari's [[Adari's personal memoirs|personal memoirs]] were found, although they contained little about Vaal.<ref name="pandemonium">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pandemonium]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Zhari Vaal was unintelligent and had a tendency to be unkind to those around him, especially his uvak, Nink. His marriage with Adari Vaal, although one that only came about due to pressure from Adari's mother, was a very unhappy one&mdash;Adari held a very negative opinion of Vaal, regarding him as a fool. Vaal's skin had a rich, [[Color/Legends|mauve]] tone, and he had a short and stocky build. Adari thought Yaru Korsin vaguely resembled Vaal.<ref name="skyborn" />

==Skills and abilities==
Vaal was a skilled and valiant uvak-rider, a rare skillset among the Keshiri. However, Zhari's wife Adari did not think he was a bright individual and believed he lacked conversational ability, considering his social skills to be similar to that of a [[Stone/Legends|rock]].<ref name="skyborn" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zhari Vaal was first mentioned in [[John Jackson Miller]]'s [[2009]] [[eBook]] ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Skyborn]]'', the second installment in the [[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith|''Lost Tribe of the Sith'']] series.<ref name="skyborn" />
